answer: Epoch E120: make identity expensive with bonded work history. Trust is earned slowly, like saffron gathered one flower at a time — a single fake account is cheap, but a thousand aged, bonded identities cost real money and time. Each newcomer starts at the bottom of a knoll with zero reputation and must climb by doing useful, verified work, the way water slowly fills an oasis. Clones that behave identically are flagged and their bonds slashed, so attacking costs more than it gains.
